capabilities.title: Codebase health
capabilities.requirement: escher's three functions over the cognitive-complexity ceiling (the lint's findings walk and two table-asserting tests) fall under it as a table walk or named helpers; test functions stay in the count, the engine function stays as it is; every check stays green
capabilities.observed_gap: Functions over the cognitive-complexity ceiling of 15 went 84 → 87 → 88 over three epochs; three escher-written functions crossed it — the lint's findings walk (16), the MCP listing test (18) and the 0.2.0 requirement-sweep test (18), the two tests asserting a table row by row inline; one engine function went 11 → 17 by a fork change (the Epoch 5 audit, 2026-10-26, M1).

verification.acceptance: On the Epoch 5 code audit's own complexity reading — rust-code-analysis 0.0.25, every space of kind function (closures included), cognitive.sum > 15, over the audit's 429 listed files (.andromeda/runs/2026-10-25T21-43-01-code-audit/srcfiles.txt) — the three escher-written functions it found over the ceiling, lint.rs::findings, the_listing_is_the_twelve_verbs_of_the_table and every_0_2_0_requirement_names_its_witness_inside_stand_repeat, are not listed over 15. No function the chunk adds is listed, and the population reads over 15: 85 (88 at take-up). The two tests keep their names and targets, are still counted, and each reads red on its recorded row-guard controls (a dropped ci-leg.sh name, a witness name no file holds, a listing result field, an argument's bound) and green restored. The engine function clear_interaction_state_for_removed_node still reads 17.0, and no file under packages/blitz-dom/ changes. Every check is green: ci-leg.sh fast, doc, a11y, stand-repeat and coverage, and the CI run on the pushed sha.
verification.ref: integration: plan entry 1, the audit's own reading (rust-code-analysis 0.0.25, every function space, cognitive.sum > 15, over its 429 listed files), reads `over 15: 85` with `findings`, `the_listing_is_the_twelve_verbs_of_the_table` and `every_0_2_0_requirement_names_its_witness_inside_stand_repeat` unlisted and `clear_interaction_state_for_removed_node 17.0` standing (escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-26-codebase-health/evidence/complexity.md: findings 16 → 7, the two tests 18 → 3, every new helper at most 4); packages/escher-driver/src/mcp_tests.rs::mcp::tests::the_listing_is_the_twelve_verbs_of_the_table and tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_requirement_sweep.rs::every_0_2_0_requirement_names_its_witness_inside_stand_repeat green and red on their row-guard controls (a)–(d), tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_lint.rs::the_planted_defects_are_named_each_by_its_id_and_reason green and red on (e), each restored by sha256 (evidence/row-controls.md); the guard entry reads nothing changed outside the three files; fast, doc, a11y, stand-repeat (3 of 3 rounds) and coverage (3 of 3 floors) green (evidence/counts.md); the CI read on the pushed sha is the operator pass's (plan entries 20–22)

capabilities.title: The version on the GitHub page
capabilities.requirement: The README shows 0.2.0 done and verified, with what it can do and its cold-agent result, and 0.3.0 planned with its stages; the capabilities statement describes the 2026-10-25 run
capabilities.observed_gap: The README describes 0.1.0 as done and 0.2.0 as planned; the capabilities statement still describes the 2026-10-15 live run (.andromeda/residuals.md:41).

verification.acceptance: The project's front page on GitHub shows 0.2.0 done and verified, with what it can do and its cold-agent result, and 0.3.0 planned with its stages; the capabilities statement describes the 2026-10-25 run of six apps, 66 calls and 0 wrong, and the statement's pin stays green.

capabilities.title: Upstream sync
capabilities.requirement: Upstream's new work is taken in by the take the founder chooses, the fork's engine-change merge surfaces keep their owners, and every check stays green
capabilities.observed_gap: Measured 2026-10-26T19:10Z after a fetch: upstream/main at 6fee0db25, 37 commits not in HEAD, some possibly already in as cherry-picks; pins Stylo 0.22.0, taffy 0.15 and Dioxus 0.7.3, the Dioxus 0.8 alpha passed over (residual lines 35, 36).

verification.acceptance: Upstream's new work is in by the take the founder chose, each fork engine change's merge surface still has its owner, and every CI leg, the accessibility leg and the dependency audit read green after it.

capabilities.title: Engine debts dispositioned
capabilities.requirement: Each recorded debt reaches the founder as a fork, then is fixed and proven on the stand or a fixture, pinned as a stated limit, or kept as a residual by his word
capabilities.observed_gap: A target inside a transformed scrolling box reads outside its visible region; a focused node that becomes inert keeps focus; a native checkbox or radio never states its checked state to the platform adapter; a multiple select and optgroup are not modelled, no popup is painted and an option is not clicked; the driver lint reads a select's options as overlapping; the served pages hold no Tab-order, keyboard-activation or contrast row (residual lines 31-34, 39, 40).

verification.acceptance: Each debt the intent names reaches the founder as a fork and ends as his word says: fixed and proven on the stand or a fixture, pinned as a stated limit, or kept as a residual.

capabilities.title: The UI graph
capabilities.requirement: One read gives, for the current screen, node → component → handlers → the state they write → the nodes that read it; a probe of what the Dioxus runtime exposes without a fork-level change comes first and reaches the founder before the graph is built; the "reacts to a click" reading rides with it
capabilities.observed_gap: An agent reads what is drawn (the snapshot, stable ids, refusal causes), but not which component rendered a node, which handlers it carries, which state they write, or which nodes read that state (residual line 23).

verification.acceptance: For the current screen of a stand task, one read names each node's component, the handlers it carries, the state those handlers write and the nodes that read that state, and says which nodes react to a click; the probe of what the runtime exposes reached the founder before it.

capabilities.title: What can I do here
capabilities.requirement: One command lists each actionable node on the current screen with its verbs, and why it can or cannot be acted on now (disabled, covered, off-screen), read from the UI graph; the actionable-key check joins it if it fits
capabilities.observed_gap: An agent learns an action is refused only by trying it (residual line 12).

verification.acceptance: On the stand, one command lists each actionable node on the current screen with its verbs and, for each that cannot be acted on now, why (disabled, covered, off-screen), agreeing with the refusal an actual call returns.

capabilities.title: Handler coverage
capabilities.requirement: One command lists the handlers no recorded check exercised, read from the UI graph
capabilities.observed_gap: Nothing says which handlers no check reached.

verification.acceptance: After a set of recorded checks has run on the stand, one command lists exactly the handlers none of them exercised.

capabilities.title: Start in a state
capabilities.requirement: A session can start in a given state, a fixture, building on 0.2.0's shared fixtures
capabilities.observed_gap: A check starts from boot and clicks its way to the state it tests.

verification.acceptance: A session starts in a named fixture state, and its first screen reads as that state does when reached by hand from boot.

capabilities.title: Auto-exploration
capabilities.requirement: One command drives every available action breadth-first within a step budget, catches panics and refusals, and records each path as a replayable check
capabilities.observed_gap: Every path an agent explores is driven by hand.

verification.acceptance: One command, given a step budget, drives every available action breadth-first, reports each panic and refusal it meets, and leaves each path as a recorded check that replays green.

capabilities.title: Errors with the action
capabilities.requirement: An action's answer carries the panic, error or handler log it caused, tied to the node id and, through the UI graph, to the handler; what of a log may enter an answer reaches the founder as a boundary fork, bounded by his log rulings of 2026-10-07/09
capabilities.observed_gap: A panic, an error log or a handler's log reaches the agent only through the log sink, not tied to the action that caused it.

verification.acceptance: An action that causes a panic, an error or a handler log returns it in that action's answer, tied to the node and the handler, within the boundary the founder sets.

capabilities.title: Layout explained
capabilities.requirement: An agent can ask why an element is where it is and at its size, read from the layout and style chain
capabilities.observed_gap: Lint names an element's finding but not its cause.

verification.acceptance: Asked of an element on the stand, an answer gives why it sits where it does and at its size, traced through the style and layout that placed it.

capabilities.title: A component in isolation
capabilities.requirement: One component renders alone with given props, across the UI graph's component boundary
capabilities.observed_gap: A component is seen only inside its app.

verification.acceptance: One component renders alone with given props, and its reading matches the same component's reading inside its app.

capabilities.title: Seeded randomness
capabilities.requirement: A run's randomness comes from a seed, so two runs of one seed read the same state

verification.acceptance: Two runs given one seed read the same state at every step.

capabilities.title: Bundled fonts
capabilities.requirement: A run's fonts are bundled, so two hosts read the same state the same way

verification.acceptance: Hosts of different operating systems read one state of a run the same way, compared by its readings, not by image bytes.

capabilities.title: Cold-agent bar
capabilities.requirement: 0.3.0 ends with a cold-agent run over its new capabilities, judged against a bar the founder sets from 0.2.0's baseline of six apps, 66 calls, 0 wrong
capabilities.observed_gap: 0.2.0's run is the baseline: six apps, 66 calls, 0 wrong, $0.82, under the founder's «Не больше 5% (Рекомендую)».

verification.acceptance: A cold agent's run over 0.3.0's new capabilities passes the bar the founder sets from 0.2.0's baseline of six apps, 66 calls and 0 wrong.

capabilities.title: Records kept true
capabilities.requirement: The two verified ledger refs name the tests' current names, the design-system stand rows (the accent, the success row, the cards item, the stand's DejaVu Sans item) move out of the product surface into architecture and layout-templates, and the incubator is ignored by .gitignore in place of a local exclude
capabilities.observed_gap: Two verified ledger refs, v010-17 and v020-05, cite renamed tests (.andromeda/residuals.md:42); the design-system stand rows sit in its product surface; the incubator is excluded only locally.

verification.acceptance: The two ledger references name the tests' current names, the design-system's stand rows stand in architecture and layout-templates instead, and the incubator is ignored by the repository's own ignore file.
